question: Can q50 alone assess reliability?
current_answer: No. q50 is the reported and published score, but the stability question needs q25/q75/cnt, raw arrays, per-run grouping, CV, and first-key distributions.
threshold_decision: Keep q50 compatibility but add reliability extraction from artifacts.
why_it_matters: A q50-only dashboard can hide variance changes, retained-tail movement, and first retained key artifacts.
evidence_needed: Archive compact raw files and compute q25/q75/cnt/CV/per-key distributions before declaring reliability unchanged.
